summary: The TUI demo shows the shared generated fleet-mid-refactor scenario through the Rust reader and live screen adapter

replay.detail: Demo initial state is read from embedded scenario slices; no persisted graph replay changes.

schema.detail: No wire or persisted schema changes; demo-world.json remains a derived client fixture.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Demo content changes to the shared generated world. Live worktrees no longer display invented demo rows. Strict scenario decode errors stop demo startup before raw terminal mode.

manual.detail: No upgrade steps. Fixture maintainers regenerate the derived world and first-frame golden with STUI_UPDATE_CONTRACT=1.

recovery.detail: No upgrade state changes to recover.
